acceptanceCriteria: A commit that only mentions an ID in prose yields CITED, not DELIVERED; a closing trailer or a ticket-scoped subject yields DELIVERED.
The default scan covers history back to the ticket's creation, or each ticket left unscanned reports TRUNCATED rather than NOT_OBSERVED.
A regression test covers a mention-only commit and a ticket older than the scan window.
body: Observed 2026-10-21 (corvint-tasks local build). `ticket delivery-screen <170 ids> --ref origin/main --limit 10000` scanned 8717 commits and reported 154 DELIVERED. That count includes MANUAL/EXTERNAL release tickets such as V1-0019 and V1-0014, whose IDs only appear in commit messages as mentions, and 72 tickets that a single commit merely cites. Without --limit the default 1000-commit scan reported NOT_OBSERVED for tickets cited in older commits, and --limit above 10000 is refused as MALFORMED. Expected: tell a citation that delivers the ticket (a Fixes/Refs trailer or a ticket-scoped subject) apart from a mention, and report CITED rather than DELIVERED for a bare mention; by default, scan back to the store's creation commit, or report the truncation per ticket.
